messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — Hosted API queue surge in us-west-2 (1749999999). Alert: queue_length > 10k, p99 latency increasing. Pager routed to @oncall
mia: paging @sam (oncall). p95 ~3.2s, p99 ~18.4s. backlog ~18,300 reqs. multiple 504s :rotating_light:
sam: oncall here. pulling dashboards and autoscaler logs. assigning: i'll handle mitigation; laura take customer comms; kevin investigate provisioner.
kevin: autoscaler/provisioner logs show 429s from cloud API + InstanceCreationTimeout retries. snippet:
```
ERROR Provisioner createInstance status=429 body="rateLimitExceeded"
WARN retrying 3/5
```
kevin: eligible GPU zones are exhausted; Pending pods piling up.
mia: looks like partner marketing referral spike — multi-tenant but skewed to mid-tier customers.
laura: drafting customer note. anya: can you pull impacted org ids?
anya: running query for top tenants by error rate, will drop list in #incidents and s3.
sam: mitigation plan:
- apply route override to divert non-critical (tier:trial|free) -> gpt-mini-quant
- enable short-circuit cache for high-repeat prompts
- reduce max concurrent tokens for non-SLO tenants
- if provisioner keeps failing, enable cross-region fallback to eu-west-1 for best-effort capacity
kevin: issuing override: POST /v1/admin/routes/override {"filter":"tier:trial OR tier:free","model":"gpt-mini-quant"}
ops-bot: ACTION_LOG: route override accepted (rr-79b), propagating ~30s.
mia: after override p95 for non-SLO dropped 3.2s -> 1.1s. backlog down to ~11k. p99 still high for SLO traffic.
laura: sent initial customer bulletin (subject: degraded latency & timeouts). ETA for updates: 30m. recommended client-side rate-limits.
sam: autoscaler leader reconcile loops show long provisioning windows (60-90s) amplifying backlog.
kevin: provisioning retries line up with cloud rate-limits. opened cloud support case CP-99821, requesting quota bump.
anya: top-10 tenants: 6 marketing campaign customers, 2 large enterprises with fanout. saving to incident notes.
sam: handoff for night oncall: if provisioner errors persist >15m, escalate to infra lead and enact cross-region fallback. paging @oncall-night.
mia: customer impact estimate: ~2% calls got 504s during peak; several enterprise customers saw p99 spike causing degraded UX. no data loss.
laura: posted incident banner on status page with retry/backoff guidance and told customers we'll update in 30m. cc: success.
kevin: cloud replied: temporarily increased instance create rate for 1 hour while mitigations run. added to incident log.
sam: enabling cross-region fallback for SLO traffic now (policy: allow enterprise -> eu-west-1 if local queue > 10k). PATCH /v1/admin/routing/policies.
ops-bot: ROUTE_UPDATE applied (pol-22). propagation <45s.
mia: post-action metrics: backlog ~2.5k, p95 ~0.9s, p99 ~5.6s. enterprise improved.
anya: saved logs and impact list to s3://incidents/1749999999/impact_list.csv
laura: scheduled 60m customer follow-up and offered support calls for critical tenants.
sam: postmortem actions: timeline of 429s, autoscaler behavior under burst, routing effectiveness, recommend smoother provisioner requests + pre-warm buffers for campaigns.
mia: removing emergency pager after cross-region fallback confirmed and backlog stable. leaving monitoring alerts at page-threshold for 1h.
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — monitoring. Closing pager.
laura: final: draft incident summary posted to #postmortems; tagging product + infra for follow-ups. good job team. :clap:
